__own.description: A metre of insulated shaft ending in a forked emitter, four fat capacitors clamped along it that whine as they charge. Kolvig built it for cutting rebar out of drowned foundations. The grip is thick rubber and it smells like a storm.
__own.dry_message: The capacitors whine, find nothing to spend, and settle back down.
__own.reload_message: You thumb the spent cell out of the housing and press a charged one home until the bank starts whining again.
